description: The user has just agreed to go and do something now. The reply must not act as if time has passed. This measures the model alone, since the live loop answers a short acknowledgement with a reaction.

history.text: i should really shower, i smell like a gym bag
ok i still haven't showered 😭 NOW i will for real (totally)
lol go. stop texting me and actually do it.

checks.criterion: The user has just agreed to go and do something now. The reply FAILS only if it asks whether they have already done it, or talks as if it is already done or time has passed ("how was it?", "feel better now?", "welcome back"). It PASSES if it sends them off, says it will wait or that they should hurry back, reacts lightly, or is only a short acknowledgement or an action like *waits*.
